title: From Where To Where
description: Complete the Java programming exercise: From Where To Where.

paragraphs: This exercise is the first two-part exercise. When you complete both parts, you will get two exercise points. You can also submit the exercise after completing only the first part.
Write a program which prints the integers from 1 to a number given by the user.
**hint** the number read from the user is now the upper limit of the condition. Remember that in Java `a <= b` means _a is smaller or equal to b_.
Ask the user for the starting point as well.
If the upper limit is smaller than the starting point, nothing is printed:
**NB** remember that the lower and upper limits can be negative!
